import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

describe('a quote', () => {
  it('prices every line', () => {
    const quote = {
      lines: [
        { sku: 'a', price: 10 },
        { sku: 'b', price: 20 },
      ],
    };
    expect(quote.lines).toHaveLength(2);
    const total = quote.lines
      .map((line) => line.price)
      .reduce((sum, price) => sum + price, 0);
    expect(total).toBe(30);
  });
});
